author: Sarah Le Cornu
text: Hi everyone, can anyone recommend someone reliable to mow my lawn? It's getting completely out of hand and I've hurt my back so can't do it myself. First Tower area, St Helier. Happy to pay. Thanks in advance! 🌱

author: Mike Renouf
text: Looking for a couple of strong lads to help move a sofa and two wardrobes from St Aubin up to Gorey this Saturday morning. Should only take a couple of hours. Will pay cash 💪

author: Jane Fowler
text: Does anyone know someone good with computers who could pop round? My laptop is running so slow and I can't get my emails to work. I'm in St Clement, elderly and not very techy I'm afraid! Would pay for their time.

author: Emma de Gruchy
text: After a GCSE maths tutor for my daughter, ideally once a week on a Thursday evening. We're over in St Saviour near Five Oaks. What are people paying these days? TIA x

author: Tom Baudains
text: We need a dog walker for our Labrador, Monday to Friday afternoons while we're both back at work. St Ouen area, ongoing arrangement. She's very friendly and well behaved! Happy to pay a fair rate.

author: Chris Hamon
text: Can anyone recommend a cleaner for a one-off deep clean before we move out of our flat in Havre des Pas? Needs doing by the end of the month. Oven and bathrooms mainly.

author: Karen Mauger
text: For sale: kids' bike, great condition, £20. Collection from Grouville. First come first served, no holds! 🚲

author: Bob Le Feuvre
text: Just wanted to say a massive thank you to everyone who helped look for our cat Marmite yesterday — he turned up this morning safe and sound. This island is amazing ❤️

author: Lisa Ahier
text: We're throwing a surprise 60th next weekend and need a couple of people to help set up tables, chairs and decorations on the Saturday morning. Trinity parish hall. Cash paid for a few hours' work 🎉

author: Paul Gallichan
text: Is there anyone kind who could pick up a prescription from the pharmacy and drop it to my mum in St Martin a couple of times a week? She's housebound at the moment. Happy to sort you out for petrol and time.

author: Debbie Vibert
text: Does anyone else think the roadworks on Victoria Avenue are getting completely ridiculous now?? 😩 Took me 40 minutes to get into town this morning.

author: Nathan Le Sueur
text: Looking for someone to keep on top of our garden over the summer — mowing and a bit of weeding every couple of weeks would be ideal. We're in St Brelade near Red Houses. Would pay £30 a visit.

author: Hayley Journeaux
text: Need a hand assembling some flat pack furniture (two Ikea wardrobes and a chest of drawers). I'm useless at it! St Lawrence. Can pay for a couple of hours.
